documents.title: Worker crash recovery
documents.text:
# Worker crash recovery

When a worker disappears, stale RUNNING evaluations are requeued after worker failure.
The recover_stale_running procedure checks started_at against a stale threshold.

## Details

Jobs that still have attempts remaining return to QUEUED.
Exhausted attempts become FAILED with stale_exhausted.

documents.title: Claiming with SKIP LOCKED
documents.text:
# Claiming jobs

Workers claim the next job using FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED so concurrent workers do not block each other.
This is the durable Postgres queue claim pattern.

documents.title: Idempotent effects
documents.text:
# Idempotency

At-least-once execution is acceptable when effects are idempotent.
Overwrite the same result_key and use conditional completion on worker_id.

documents.title: Database transaction retries
documents.text:
# Database transaction retries

Transient serialization failures may retry the transaction.
Do not confuse this with ingestion job retries after worker crash recovery.

documents.title: Code symbols
documents.text:
# Code

```python
def recover_stale_running(stale_before, max_attempts):
    """Requeue or fail stale RUNNING rows."""
    return contain_and_requeue()
```

Callers must not invoke recover_stale_running while a prior root_pid is alive.

documents.title: File locking noise
documents.text:
# File locking

Application-level file locks are unrelated to SQL row locks.
A locked file does not imply SKIP LOCKED semantics.

documents.title: Unicode notes
documents.text:
# Unicode

Canonical text preserves 你好 and Café and emoji 🚀 for provenance.
Chunk budgets count Unicode code points, not UTF-8 bytes.

documents.title: Upload streaming
documents.text:
# Large uploads

Stream multipart bodies to .incoming then atomic finalize to the final artifact key.
Streaming is not resumability.
